question: Is Hormuz safe to sail, yes or no?

lines.text: Oman says it has rescued twenty five crew from a burning tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
Euronews says the ship was attacked and caught fire off Oman's Musandam coast.
No injuries were reported, and Oman has not said who did it.
On Thursday evening, the tanker Louise One, with twenty seven Indian crew, was hit.
Britain's UKMTO says a small boat attached two explosive devices to its hull.
The Financial Times reports Iran was behind it. Euronews says that is still unclear.
Today, Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers on routes it calls unauthorised were halted.
It says a supertanker carrying more than two million barrels exploded and caught fire.
The top US commander, Brad Cooper, says the main transit routes are clear of Iranian sea mines.
US Central Command calls Iran's mine strike claims false.
Qatari mediators are back in Tehran, pushing a deal to end the war.
Day two hundred and forty six tomorrow. Is Hormuz safe to sail, yes or no?

caption: Hormuz, Oman, Musandam: Oman says it rescued 25 crew from a burning tanker attacked off its coast, a day after the tanker Louise 1 was hit by explosives stuck to its hull. Iran's Revolutionary Guard says more tankers were halted today, while the US says the main routes are clear of mines. Is Hormuz safe to sail, yes or no?
notes_full: RITI rescue: Oman Maritime Security Centre statement Fri 30 Oct, first reported about 12:25 UTC (Business Upturn), Al Jazeera, Euronews; about 8h old at render
IRGC 2 tankers halted + supertanker fire: IRGC statements 30 Oct (Euronews 14:43 UTC, Al Jazeera); count differs (2 vs 3), script attributes 2 halted + 1 supertanker to IRGC
Louise 1: attacked Thu 29 Oct evening 25nm NE of Khasab, first reported 30 Oct 02:54 UTC (Maritime Executive); used as context, not the lead
Cooper: Friday 30 Oct, via Al Jazeera; CENTCOM 'These claims are FALSE' on X 28 Oct
Left out: IRGC 29 Oct three-tankers mine claim and MQM-170 drone claim (first reported 29 Oct, stale); Brent figure (no reliable dated source found)
